info.title: SkillMatch API
info.description:
# SkillMatch Career Intelligence & AI-Powered Job Matching Platform API
SkillMatch provides an enterprise-grade Career Intelligence API featuring:
- Candidate lifecycle & profiles with career preferences, education, experience, and project portfolios
- CV parsing, verification, and AI-driven improvement assistant
- Job discovery, saved bookmarks, and explainable multi-factor match engine
- Multi-stage job application pipeline and audit tracking
- Real-time in-app notifications and administrative composer
- AI-generated career roadmaps and progress tracking
- Interactive AI Mentor conversational assistant
- Simulated AI Interview Preparation and rubric evaluations
- Application Strategy assessments
- Administrative operations: skills taxonomy, company management, job sources & crawler ingestion, AI human-in-the-loop review queues, user moderation, audit logs, and analytics.
